editorial:
If you love big, loud, over-the-top action movies, this one is for you. The story follows Mahendra, a young man who discovers he is the son of the legendary warrior Baahubali. As he learns about his family's past, you are taken back to the kingdom of Mahishmati, where his father once ruled. The movie jumps between past and present, showing you how power, jealousy, and betrayal shaped the kingdom. The scale is huge, with massive sets, colorful costumes, and battles that feel larger than life. It is loud, dramatic, and packed with emotion.

The action scenes are the real highlight, with creative fights and stunning visuals that keep you glued to the screen. The acting is strong across the board. On the downside, the movie is very long and can feel slow in the middle, and some moments are a bit over the top. Still, if you enjoy epic fantasy adventures, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the truth behind the famous question of why Kattappa killed Baahubali. It turns out Bhallaladeva, Baahubali's jealous cousin, tricked Kattappa into doing it by threatening his family. Baahubali had just been named king, and Bhallaladeva could not accept it. After learning this, Mahendra confronts Bhallaladeva in a massive final battle. Mahendra wins, frees the kingdom, and takes his rightful place as ruler, bringing peace to Mahishmati.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves epic fantasy adventures and big action set pieces.
